I am a [child of the 80s](http://www.relaxorium.com/80s1.html) (Atari, not Nintendo), so I’m very interested in the upcoming CGI [Transformers movie](http://www.transformersmovie.com/). True, I’m married with two little ones, which means I go to the movies about once a year, twice if you count the annual Pixar product. Still, graphics are cool, and so I was pretty excited to see [these shots](http://www.michaelbay.com/blog/files/d58812e5a390e8b3a44162285e4ae054-74.html) of what the new transformers look like.

Here’s a shot from the old cartoon:
